headline: Apple says iPhone Duo tops 100,000 optimized apps
summary: Two weeks after the iPhone Duo foldable went on sale, Apple said the App Store has surpassed 100,000 apps optimized for it, with thousands more arriving daily, and VP Susan Prescott praised developers for quickly embracing the device.

claims.statement: Apple said the App Store now has more than 100,000 apps optimized for the iPhone Duo foldable.

sources.quote: The iPhone Duo has more than 100,000 optimized apps, Apple says
There are now 100,000 Duo-optimized apps, says Apple

claims.statement: The iPhone Duo had been on sale for two weeks at the time of the announcement.

sources.quote: Apple's iPhone Duo has been officially on sale for two weeks

claims.statement: Apple VP Susan Prescott said developers had quickly embraced the iPhone Duo.

sources.quote: It's been wonderful to see how quickly developers have embraced iPhone Duo, and we're grateful for their creativity and innovation,

claims.statement: Techcrunch reports thousands more optimized apps are arriving daily.
